instruction: The Great Wall of China extends from Shanhaiguan in the east. Find the point 100 km west of Shanhaiguan along the wall.
Stonehenge is located 13 km north of Salisbury in Wiltshire, England.
The Taj Mahal is situated on the banks of the Yamuna River in Agra. Find the area 3 km south of the Taj Mahal.
Petra is located approximately 240 km south of Amman, the capital of Jordan.
The Suez Canal connects Port Said on the Mediterranean to Suez on the Red Sea. Find the midpoint of the canal.
Angkor Wat is situated 6 km north of the modern town of Siem Reap in Cambodia.
The Panama Canal runs from Colon on the Atlantic to Panama City on the Pacific. The Gatun Locks are located roughly one-quarter of the way from Colon.
Mount Kilimanjaro rises 5,895 m above sea level, located 330 km south of the equator near the town of Moshi in Tanzania.
The Chunnel entrance on the French side is near Calais. The English entrance is near Folkestone. Find the midpoint under the English Channel, then shift 5 km east towards the English coast.
The Trans-Siberian Railway connects Moscow to Vladivostok. The halfway point is near Irkutsk. Find the quarter-way point from Moscow.
